categories.main_business_segments: Noevir Holdings operates three main business segments: Cosmetics, Pharmaceuticals & Food, and Other Businesses. The Cosmetics segment includes the manufacturing and sales of cosmetics, toiletries, and beauty accessories. The Pharmaceuticals & Food segment covers the manufacturing and sales of over-the-counter drugs, quasi-drugs, and health foods. The Other Businesses segment includes apparel, body fashion, aircraft and vessel sales, air transportation, and pilot training services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced R&D in skincare, makeup, and health foods, integrating botanical research and dermatological science. Key technologies include proprietary multi-layer liposome delivery systems, plant extract formulations, and functional food ingredient development. Production is supported by in-house manufacturing facilities and research centers, with a focus on high-quality, innovative formulations and sustainable sourcing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include individual consumers seeking skincare and beauty products, as well as health-conscious individuals for supplements and OTC drugs. Major sales channels are direct sales via counseling-based agents, drugstores, variety shops, dermatology clinics, and medical institutions. The company also serves B2B clients through OEM cosmetics manufacturing and has a presence in the aviation and apparel markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales and assets. Internationally, it operates subsidiaries in the United States, Canada, Taiwan, China, and Europe (San Marino), with overseas activities focused on cosmetics and health foods. Most production and R&D facilities are located in Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Noevir Holdings is primarily positioned downstream as a manufacturer and brand owner, selling finished products to end consumers through direct sales, retail, and wholesale channels. It also engages in some midstream activities through OEM manufacturing for other brands and distributes imported goods in select segments.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include sustainable growth through innovation in the Japanese market, brand value enhancement, and diversification of human resources, R&D, production, and logistics. R&D focuses on integrating skincare and makeup science, developing high-value-added products, and addressing consumer health and beauty needs. The company also emphasizes environmental sustainability, such as reducing packaging waste and sourcing sustainable raw materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of cosmetics, toiletries, OTC drugs, quasi-drugs, and health foods to consumers and retailers. The company also earns income from OEM manufacturing, apparel and aviation-related sales, and service fees from air transportation and pilot training. Direct sales via agents and wholesale to retailers are key revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Noevir Holdings competes with major Japanese and global cosmetics and health product companies, such as Shiseido, Kao, and Rohto. It differentiates itself through a strong direct sales network, counseling-based sales, and a focus on sensitive skin and natural ingredients. The company holds a solid position in the Japanese market, especially in counseling cosmetics and functional foods.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥64.7 billion, with operating profit of ¥11.1 billion and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of ¥8.0 billion, marking a record high. The company has shown steady growth in sales and profits over the past five years, maintains a high equity ratio (70.3%), and has over 1,350 employees. Cash flow is robust, with significant internal reserves and stable dividend payments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Noevir Holdings emphasizes high-quality, research-driven products that combine natural ingredients with advanced dermatological science, catering to sensitive skin and health-conscious consumers. Its unique value lies in personalized, counseling-based sales, proprietary botanical research, and a strong reputation for safety and efficacy. The company also highlights its commitment to sustainability and social responsibility as part of its brand differentiation.
